notes:
学习者证据 Harness、Profile 归纳可靠性与三词典标签修复
1. 学习联想气泡不再把 AI 的改正当成你的进步：说“你用对了 / 又犯了”时逐字引用原文，核对不通过不显示。
2. 气泡变成可有可无的“学习联想”：无值得说的不出现，不再凑数。未经新规则核对的旧气泡会自动隐藏。
3. IN 模式不再表扬或批评别人写的句子：输入学习仅提示涉及在学内容，不评判外部句子。
4. 追问时 AI 引用的是你的原句：原句与 AI 改句分开传递，追问能逐字引用你真正写下的内容。
5. IN / OUT 画像不再互相串线：分键收回，归属由代码决定，未动路线不改写。
6. “掌握度”只认你亲手写出的英文：标为“已掌握”至少需要两句不同的、经程序核对的自主表达。
7. 后台归纳不再悄悄丢记录：发送、核对、删除用同一批记录，超出上限继续排队。
8. 后台归纳不再被截断：输出上限提高，发给 AI 内容更精简。
9. 历史搜索词不再被当作真实单词：随手打错的搜索串不再附会词义。
10. 词典「可数 / 不可数」等变成小标签：剥离释义前乱括号，各词典正确定位标签。
11. 英汉词典释义修复：补回丢失左括号，纠正将情景误作释义的条目，恢复 bench「法官」等义项。
12. 词典与联想修复：英越/英英词典标签与缺失义项修复，搜索联想重复查询后粘贴立即响应。
13. 浏览器扩展与其他平台同一个 Release 发版：ZIP 直接挂在对应版本号下。
14. Pure Core 词典释义模组：可调位置、可自由开启或关闭。

notes_en:
Learner Evidence Harness, Profile Reliability & Dictionary Tag Fixes
1. Learning Insight Bubble Provenance: The insight bubble now only highlights actual learner words that survived correction; no credit given for AI-introduced corrections.
2. Unintrusive Learning Associations: Bubbles only appear when there are genuine patterns to discuss, without forced suggestions. Old unchecked bubbles are hidden.
3. IN Mode Separation: Queries on external reading material only hint at related points without grading external sentences.
4. AI Follow-ups Quote Original Input: Clarification queries reference user original text instead of AI-rewritten sentences.
5. Strict IN / OUT Profile Isolation: Grouped separately to avoid cross-contamination; inactive routes remain untouched.
6. Mastery Requires Real Autonomous Output: Marking weakness as mastered requires at least two validated learner productions.
7. Profile Queue Integrity: Truncation and drop issues in background batch diagnosis resolved.
8. Increased Profile Max Output Tokens: Raised tokens to prevent JSON truncation on Gemini models.
9. Noise Exclusion: Accidental search inputs are never treated as vocabulary weaknesses.
10. Cleaner Dictionary Tags: Part-of-speech & countability tags extracted cleanly from definition brackets across all dictionaries.
11. English-Chinese Dictionary Fixes: Restored missing opening parentheses, corrected scenario tags misplaced as definitions, and fixed omitted senses.
12. English-Vietnamese, English-English & Suggestion Fixes: Fixed POS fragments, restored missing senses, and fixed immediate suggestion on prefix paste.
13. Extension Ships with App Release: Extension ZIPs now release directly alongside desktop and mobile packages under the same tag.
14. Pure Core Dictionary Meanings Module: Position can be reordered or toggled in Settings.
